Claim amendment · `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh` · 2026-10-27T17:48Z

Supersedes the `File surface` line of claim 6446870967. Everything else in it stands.

File surface: everything the claim named, plus `packages/lint` `translation-target-unknown`. The lint gains a `books.NAME` arm (a `namedItemGroups` row with `namesOf('books')`) and a `groups.KEY` sub-leg, with its test and a header line. The surface also takes in `ui/packages/app-shell` `TranslationPreview` (its exhaustive group table needs the `books` row) and the fix for any CI red the new group causes. Stop on a breach and explain it in the report.

Why: the contract review of PR #26819 (`6449452917`, PASS) found that a mistyped book name or group key lints clean. The two most recent named groups shipped their lint arm in the same PR (#25701 positions/permissions, #25826 reports), and the lint's own header calls an orphan key actively misleading. So the arm goes in this PR, not a follow-up.
